translations.web: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”
translations.bsb: On their way out, they said to one another, “This man has done nothing worthy of death or imprisonment.”
translations.kjv: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.
translations.asv: and when they had withdrawn, they spake one to another, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.
